operations.name: Saw Cut Stock
operations.setup_note: Cut the provisional round-bar blank to length with allowance for facing both ends.

operations.name: CNC Turn — First Setup
operations.setup_note: Chuck the blank and face the first end to establish an axial reference. Rough and finish the turned profiles, leaving the outer sleeve OD with allowance for the specified later grind.

operations.name: CNC Turn — Reverse Setup
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part and locate on the turned profile, protecting the finished surfaces. Face the opposite end to establish the specified axial length.

operations.name: Cross-Hole Drilling
operations.setup_note: Fixture the turned metal part with its main axis aligned to the setup datum and locate the transverse hole from the drawing. Drill before coating and rubber bonding.

operations.name: Deburr Machined Metal Parts
operations.setup_note: Remove sharp edges and cross-hole burrs from the machined metal parts before phosphate coating.

operations.name: Phosphate Coat
operations.setup_note: Clean and phosphate the machined metal parts before rubber mold bonding. Batch the order of 10 together if the line's normal rack capacity permits.

operations.name: Rubber Mold Bond
operations.setup_note: Send the phosphated metal components for rubber molding and bond-to-bar-pin processing per the stated SAE J200 callout. Confirm the vendor's tooling and lot capacity for 10 pieces.
operations.outside_process: rubber molding and mold bonding to bar pin

operations.name: Outer Tube OD Grind
operations.setup_note: Locate the bonded part to grind the outer-tube OD to its drawing size. The drawing note permits localized phosphate removal at the OD grind; no heat-treatment step is specified.

operations.name: Oil and Identify
operations.setup_note: Apply a light coat of oil to the ground outer-tube surface and identify one end of the bar pin with a blue stripe or daub.

operations.name: Final Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect the completed part for drawing dimensions, visible coating condition, deburring, the required blue identification mark, and compliance with the referenced part requirements.

clarifications.question: Are the bar pin and outer tube separate starting components, and what blank form and dimensions should be used for each?
clarifications.suggested_default: Proceed provisionally with a 75 mm hot-rolled round-bar envelope for the in-house machined metal blank; revise the stock plan when the component blank details are confirmed.

clarifications.question: What material grade, condition, and hardness apply to the outer tube, and is its OD grind required without a prior hardening operation?
clarifications.suggested_default: Retain the drawing-called OD grind and treat the material as medium machinability until the material and hardness are confirmed.

clarifications.question: Which revision of TS-839310 governs the phosphate coating requirements?
clarifications.suggested_default: Apply the customer-approved phosphate process and acceptance criteria referenced by the current TS-839310 revision.

assumptions.text: Because the blank is unstated and the stock schema allows one form only, a provisional hot-rolled round-bar blank is used; the drawing notes imply the finished bushing may contain separate metal components.
Material grade, supplied condition, and hardness are absent, so medium machinability is assumed for the metal machining operations.

The phosphate coat is applied before rubber bonding and OD grinding because the drawing permits localized coating removal from OD grinding and calls for mold bonding to the bar pin; this overrides the usual all-machining-before-coating sequence for the specified grind.

No precision area requiring masking is identified, and no cure or bake requirement is stated for the phosphate coating; masking, unmasking, and cure/bake steps are therefore omitted pending the coating specification.

Center drilling and lathe part-off are omitted because the provisional blank is saw-cut to length, its length-to-diameter ratio does not require tailstock support, and it is not treated as bar-fed stock.
The drawing explicitly calls for OD grinding but does not specify heat treatment. The grind is retained as a drawing-required step pending confirmation of material hardness and process condition.
The 6.2 mm edge radii are produced with form turning before coating; generic sharp-edge requirements are handled by deburring rather than by adding unspecified chamfers.
Rubber mold bonding is represented as an outside process because no rubber-molding capability is listed in-house; no rubber feature ID is present to assign as a target.
